purpose: Reviewed program-identity mapping between the frozen DeepSeek Housing baseline and the corrected selected-8-bit Qwen Housing runs
interpretation: The union is a lower bound, not an inflated candidate total. One repeated Qwen identity is collapsed. Each unmatched DeepSeek record is retained as one program family even when its text bundles several programs. Only two clearly separate named programs hidden inside otherwise matched DeepSeek records are added. Final phone-vetted Curator packages remain the ground truth for splitting or rejecting the remaining DeepSeek bundles.
